p1: At 2 a.m., Liam's flatmate Josh texted him:
Don't turn on the lights when you get home.
Weird. Josh never texts. His phone stays on the couch.
Liam left the lights off. From the lounge room... he heard breathing.
In bed, he texted: was that you? It replied instantly.
Go to sleep. I'll be right here.
Under the covers, Liam waited. Then he looked out. Nothing.
Then the heat hit. Burning, like a fever.
Whispers started. Not in the room. Inside his head.
He couldn't breathe. He gasped for air.
Liam grabbed his arm. His last words...
Then a voice came out of Liam's mouth.
I told you... I'd be right here.
Liam and Josh were never seen again. Nobody knows what happened to them.
People never last long in that flat. They move out... or they disappear.
